description: This file is a header file defining the interface and class for eMMC diagnostics APIs in the STBService component. It declares a class for managing eMMC device information and functions to retrieve various eMMC parameters.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceXeMMC
classes.description: Class providing APIs for eMMC diagnostics, managing device info retrieval and message handling.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the class.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and releases the singleton instance.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for eMMC info.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set requests for eMMC info.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Retrieves eMMC capacity information.

methods.name: getLifeElapsedA
methods.description: Retrieves life elapsed info type A.

methods.name: getLifeElapsedB
methods.description: Retrieves life elapsed info type B.

methods.name: getLifeElapsed
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve life elapsed info based on type.

methods.name: getLotID
methods.description: Retrieves the Lot ID of the eMMC device.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves manufacturer info of the eMMC device.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves model info of the eMMC device.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the eMMC device is read-only.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves serial number of the eMMC device.

methods.name: getTSBQualified
methods.description: Retrieves TSB qualification status.

methods.name: getPreEOLStateSystem
methods.description: Retrieves pre-end-of-life state for the system.

methods.name: getPreEOLStateEUDA
methods.description: Retrieves pre-end-of-life state for EUDA.

methods.name: getPreEOLStateMLC
methods.description: Retrieves pre-end-of-life state for MLC.

methods.name: getPreEOLState
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve pre-end-of-life state based on type.

methods.name: getFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version of the eMMC device.

methods.name: getDeviceReport
methods.description: Generates a device report with detailed info.

methods.name: ~hostIf_STBServiceXeMMC()
methods.description: unavailable
